seo.title: Wedding Packages | Brick TV
seo.description: Wedding films and photography from Brick TV in Winnipeg. Work directly with the artists creating your film, from the first conversation to the final edit.

hero.headline: Your wedding, filmed by the people who got to know you.
hero.support: Work directly with the artists creating your film, from the first conversation to the final edit.
hero.alt: Bridal shoes resting on the hem of the wedding dress

section1.heading: Made to Feel Like Your Day Again.
section1.text: The quiet moments before the ceremony. The way you look at each other. The laughter, the tears, the people who came together for you. We capture your wedding with intention, so years from now, you do not just remember how it looked. You remember exactly how it felt.
section1.alt: The bride seen softly through her veil

packages.name: Story Wedding Package
packages.note: Full wedding day coverage, with more in-depth, multi-angle coverage.
items: 450 edited photos plus a physical photo album
Interviews with the bride and groom

packages.name: Premium Plus Wedding Package
packages.note: For weddings that go beyond traditional coverage. Designed for larger multi-day celebrations, destination weddings, and events needing extended or customized coverage.
packages.tail: Every Premium Plus package is tailored to the scale and needs of the wedding.
items: Multiple days of photography and videography
Travel outside the city or country

testimonials.quote: We cried watching our special day.

section2.heading: Your Story. Told Like No One Else’s.
section2.text: No two love stories are the same. That is why we approach every wedding with fresh eyes, taking the time to understand you, the people you love, and the moments that matter most. Every frame is thoughtfully crafted around your story, creating something personal, timeless, and entirely yours.
section2.alt: The bridal bouquet held in henna-painted hands

closing.heading: Every wedding starts with a conversation.
